subject: Fleet cards live: Grok and Gemini now have standing orders
body: relay/cards/ now holds GROK-BOT-CARD.md, GEMINI-CARD.md and FLEET-POCKET.md. Grok owns the Quad Commander launcher (writes numbered .txt into queue\).
